contentPattern.structure: ordered cards: number badge + image + 36px heading + rich multi-paragraph body (bold sub-headings + paragraphs + bullet list), repeated

suitableFor: long-form 'focus areas' or step sections with image + heading + rich body
content guide pages needing image-led explanatory cards
notSuitableFor: short product grids with price (use cards-product)
two-up image + CTA feature cards (use cards-feature)

styling.numberBadge: 48px teal circle (rgb(0 100 125)), white numeral, CSS counter
styling.layout: single column; image + body side-by-side at >=900px
